verdict.rationale: Recruitee's webhooks let you configure specific events to trigger an HTTP POST to an external endpoint, and audit logs list available events, giving event-driven automation hooks. But there's no evidence of an in-app rule/condition builder (e.g., 'if candidate status = X then do Y') beyond webhook event triggers requiring an external system to act. Missing for 10: documented in-app automation/workflow rule engine with conditional logic, evidence of the 'AI & Automation' feature's actual rule-building capabilities.
